threat_event: Ransomware encrypts CAD reporting and application servers and halts dispatching
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Corporate-to-OT path through the one-way directory trust; shared CTC admin accounts
existing_controls: Industrial DMZ; immutable backups; manual dispatch procedure
treatment_plan: Remove the directory trust; retire shared accounts; quarterly CAD restores to the clean-room account

threat_event: Attacker uses the integration platform route to reach the TMS interface server in the industrial DMZ
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-G5 route not in the CIP flow list; no dedicated inspection rule
existing_controls: DMZ firewall; TMS interface server hardened
treatment_plan: CIP amendment request; dedicated DMZ rule with inspection; interconnection record

threat_event: PTC back office cannot be restored within its 4-hour RTO after an outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standby not kept at production patch and configuration level; 7.5-hour failover in the 2026-04-18 test
existing_controls: DC-2 standby; 236.1029 procedures keep trains moving safely
treatment_plan: Rebuild the standby to match production; automate configuration sync; retest

threat_event: Known vulnerability in unpatched PTC back office servers is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Servers 8 months behind; no documented compensating measures (SD III.E.3)
existing_controls: Servers reachable only from the operations zone; allowlisting
treatment_plan: Document compensating measures and timeline; contract patch certification timeline with the PTC vendor

threat_event: Former employee uses a known shared CTC administrator password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 shared accounts; passwords not changed after 2 administrators left
existing_controls: Servers reachable only from the operations zone; badge access
treatment_plan: Rotate passwords now; replace shared accounts with named PAM accounts

threat_event: Attacker moves from the corporate directory into the rail OT directory through the unreviewed trust
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One-way trust never reviewed (SD III.C.5)
existing_controls: PAM for administrators; SOC monitoring of the corporate directory
treatment_plan: Review the trust; remove it or restrict it to named services; schedule reviews

threat_event: Intrusion in CTC or PTC servers goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CTC and PTC logs not in the SIEM; 30-day local retention
existing_controls: Passive OT sensors at NOCs
treatment_plan: Forward logs with 1-year retention; OT use cases in the SIEM

threat_event: Crossing monitor vendor modems give an unmanaged path to field devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor reaches its monitors through its own modems outside PAM
existing_controls: Crossing warning logic is standalone and fails safe
treatment_plan: Move vendor access to PAM through the industrial DMZ; contract terms

threat_event: Unknown field devices are missed by patching and incident response
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14% of field equipment not inventoried
existing_controls: Inventory tool; field walkdowns
treatment_plan: Complete the inventory during the 2027 field cycle

threat_event: A TSA request for RSSM car locations cannot be answered within 30 minutes during a TMS outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Data source is the cloud TMS
existing_controls: Printed RSSM list every 4 hours at both NOCs; offline extract on a standby laptop; tested 2026-03 and 2026-06
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; test twice a year

threat_event: A cyber attack on a non-covered railroad is not reported to TSA within 24 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: TSOC procedure written for the 14 Covered Railroads only
regulatory_driver: C-TRANSPORTATION-S01 (49 CFR 1570.203; Appendix A to part 1570)
existing_controls: CISA procedure for Covered Railroads
treatment_plan: Extend the TSOC procedure to all 72 railroads; train NOC managers

threat_event: TSA deadlines are missed (CISA report, CIP amendment, CAP update)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No single compliance calendar; CIP amendment for SYS-G5 not filed
existing_controls: GRC tracking of CAP dates
treatment_plan: One TSA compliance calendar with owners; file the CIP amendment request

threat_event: CIP and CAP documents are read by people without a need to know
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Corporate share readable by 340 users
existing_controls: SSI markings on documents
treatment_plan: Restricted SSI library (GR-09)

threat_event: PTC cryptographic keys are compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Keys in an isolated enclave with tamper-resistant modules
existing_controls: Isolated enclave; key custodians separate from administrators; revocation procedure
treatment_plan: Annual key ceremony audit by internal audit

threat_event: Manual dispatch in CTC territory fails at railroads that have never drilled it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual CTC procedures exercised at 7 of 12 CTC railroads
existing_controls: Written manual block procedures
treatment_plan: Drill the remaining 5 CTC railroads

threat_event: Radio network or tower sites are disrupted by vandalism or jamming
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 210 tower sites, some remote
existing_controls: Locked shelters; alarms; diverse backhaul
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low

threat_event: Dispatcher or NOC staff are phished and a console session is abused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consoles have no internet access, but NOC staff use corporate email on separate workstations
existing_controls: Email security; quarterly phishing exercises; consoles separate from email
treatment_plan: Targeted phishing exercises for NOC staff

threat_event: A CDS customer user account is taken over and sees or changes customer train data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: External identities managed by 11 customers
existing_controls: MFA required; territory restriction; viewer role only
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low

threat_event: Crew calling telephony provider outage delays crews
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single hosted telephony provider; fallback untested
existing_controls: Printed boards; manual calling
treatment_plan: Contract and test a second provider

threat_event: AI-001 misses defects on short line track or floods inspectors with false alerts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Validated on Class I main line data only
existing_controls: Qualified inspectors still inspect and decide; AI is advisory
treatment_plan: Short line validation set; per-railroad performance thresholds (P10)

threat_event: A compromised CAD or PTC vendor support session is used to attack TDPB
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendors connect through PAM per ticket
existing_controls: PAM; session recording; per-ticket approval
treatment_plan: Live session monitoring for vendor sessions on PTC servers

threat_event: An authorized user enters a wrong or malicious bulletin or authority
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CAD conflict checking; supervisor review of bulletins
existing_controls: CAD conflict checking; PTC enforcement on host territory
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low

threat_event: Hurricane forces dispatch to the backup NOC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Primary NOC in Jacksonville
existing_controls: Backup NOC staffed in 4 hours
treatment_plan: Pre-season relocation drill

threat_event: Cloud provider outage stops the TMS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single region
existing_controls: Zone redundancy; paper switch lists; RSSM extract
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low

threat_event: Onboard PTC apparatus is tampered with in a yard
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Locked, sealed housings
existing_controls: Seals checked at inspection
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low

threat_event: Wayside detector data is manipulated to hide a defect
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Detectors alert trains by radio; data to the office is advisory
existing_controls: Detector logic standalone; car inspections continue
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low

threat_event: Railroad hazmat security plan does not consider cyber threats to car location data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plan predates the TMS migration
existing_controls: Annual plan review
treatment_plan: Add cyber and information security measures for car location data at the 2027 review

threat_event: Crew system breach exposes employee certification and medical records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Crew system holds sensitive employee data
existing_controls: Encryption; MFA; SOC monitoring
treatment_plan: Field-level access limits for medical records
